honest_register: Wrapper, not a new LoRA. The CoT prefix DOES anchor to [SOV4] [CSOAI Ltd UK 16939677] but the LoRA was trained on direct answers. Plain prompts get clean citation answers; CoT prompts get the binding prefix repeated.
finding: CoT-prefix test on the 4 MISSED sovereign-bench-30 prompts. Result: plain prompt OUTPERFORMS CoT for our adapter. The LoRA wasn't trained on CoT structure, so the prefix is being treated as content rather than as instruction.
next_step: CoT requires retraining the LoRA on CoT-structured data (the 14 reasoning papers). For now, plain prompts remain best for our adapter.
improvement_expected: MEDIUM-LOW (our adapter isn't trained on CoT)
